workflow.critical: All bug report content must be verified against {reporting_language}
Execute ALL steps in exact order

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first.

step.action: Find the suite entry where name = {suite_name}

check.output: ⚠️ Suite status is "{current_status}" — bug analysis may not have run yet. Continuing validation; artifact checks will catch missing reports.

step.goal: Load bug reports and JUnit XML for cross-reference
step.action: Check if {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/junit.xml exists; if so, read it and count {failed_test_count} = number of <failure> or <error> elements
List all BUG-XXXX.md files in {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/ → {bug_report_files}; count {bug_report_count}
Read each bug report file completely

step.goal: Run all quality checks and collect issues
step.check: One bug report exists for every failed test in junit.xml — {bug_report_count} must equal {failed_test_count}. List any failure from junit.xml that has no corresponding BUG-XXXX.md.
Each report contains ALL required fields: Bug ID, عنوان المشكلة, وصف المشكلة, خطوات إعادة المشكلة, النتيجة الحالية, النتيجة المتوقعة, مستوى الخطورة, الأولوية. List any report with missing fields.

Root cause analysis is SPECIFIC in every report — NOT generic text like "unknown error", "test failed", or "something went wrong". Each RCA must include the file path, line number, and what specifically went wrong.
Bug IDs are unique and sequential (BUG-0001, BUG-0002, …) — no duplicate IDs, no gaps, no out-of-sequence numbering
Each report includes evidence: screenshot/video/trace paths (if Playwright captured them) AND console error details from junit.xml attributes

Severity is correctly classified — NOT every bug rated حرجة: 5xx response / login broken / payment broken → حرجة Functional flow blocked with no workaround → عالية UI defect with workaround → متوسطة Cosmetic / minor wording → منخفضة
Each report includes a concrete suggested fix based on the root cause analysis — NOT a generic "investigate further"
All bug report content is written in {reporting_language} — no content in another language

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed

check.output:
✅ Validation Passed — /aiqa-analyzebugs
All 8 quality checks passed. Bug reports are complete and accurate. Suite: {suite_name} | Reports verified: {bug_report_count} No issues found — safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatereport.

step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report — /aiqa-analyzebugs ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
Suite : {suite_name} Output : {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/ Failed tests : {failed_test_count} Bug reports : {bug_report_count}
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" + which reports/tests affected) (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" + which reports affected) (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}" + which reports affected) (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (for each Low issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

step.action: Determine issues to fix: Choice A → fix ALL issues Choice B → fix only Critical and High issues

For each issue selected for fixing: BG-1 → for each failure in junit.xml that has no bug report: create BUG-XXXX.md now — read the failure node for error message, stack trace, and test name; fill all required sections BG-2 → for each report missing required fields: re-read the junit.xml failure node for this test; populate every blank field with the actual error details BG-3 → check Playwright test-results/ folder for screenshots/videos/traces matching this test; add paths to report; extract console errors from junit.xml <system-err> section and add them BG-4 → re-evaluate severity for each inflated or wrong classification: re-read the error type and flow impact; adjust rating using the severity heuristic (حرجة/عالية/متوسطة/منخفضة) BG-5 → for each report with vague RCA: re-read the full stack trace; rewrite the root cause section with: specific file path, line number, what exactly failed, and why BG-6 → add a concrete suggested fix to each report that lacks one (e.g. "Update selector on line 42 of login.page.js to use getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول' })") BG-7 → translate any non-{reporting_language} content in each report to {reporting_language} BG-8 → renumber any duplicate or out-of-sequence IDs sequentially (BUG-0001, BUG-0002, …); update INDEX.md accordingly Save all modified bug reports.

step.goal: Re-verify fixed checks and report final status
step.action: Re-run ONLY the checks that were targeted for fixing
step.output:
📋 Validation Summary — /aiqa-analyzebugs
(for each fixed check:) ✅ {id} — resolved: {what was corrected} (for each still failing:) ❌ {id} — still failing: {reason} (for each skipped check:) ⏭️ {id} — skipped (outside selected fix scope)
(if all targeted checks pass:) ✅ All targeted issues resolved. Safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatereport.
(if some still fail:) ⚠️ {remaining} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Edit the bug reports manually, then re-run /aiqa-analyzebugs-validate.
